title.narrative: Raising awareness on climate change adaptation to restore and preserve water and soil resources

description.narrative: The impacts of climate change and drought are threatening the livelihoods of the inhabitants of Tlalnepantla in Mexico. 90 percent earn their living from agriculture; around seventy percent live in poverty. Water scarcity and pest infestation are directly linked to progressive forest degradation and a lack of awareness. The project strengthens the capacities of teachers, students and their parents and raises their awareness of the need to protect ecosystems. The raises awareness of measures that preserve biodiversity, restore degraded land and support farmers in switching to more sustainable farming methods – especially for the protection of soil and water resources. Based on the results, the approach is to be extended to other regions in Mexico, subject to additional resources.
